open_points: Requirement SWR-001 [iwdg_kr_key_start] references a hardware register interface (RM0486 p.2989) without an approved safety allocation, making its feasibility unclear.
The software requirements document contains open points indicating that requirement SWR-001 [iwdg_kr_key_start] references a hardware register interface without an approved safety allocation.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is to start the watchdog, the IWDG LL driver shall write the key value 0xCCCC to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the register array ll_iwdg_regs[0] contains 0xCCCC at offset IWDG_KR_OFFSET after the function call.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is to refresh the watchdog counter, the IWDG LL driver shall write the key value 0xAAAA to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the register array ll_iwdg_regs[0] contains 0xAAAA at offset IWDG_KR_OFFSET after the function call.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is to enable write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR registers, the IWDG LL driver shall write the key value 0x5555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the register array ll_iwdg_regs[0] contains 0x5555 at offset IWDG_KR_OFFSET after the function call.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is to disable write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR registers, the IWDG LL driver shall write a key value different from 0x5555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the register array ll_iwdg_regs[0] does not contain 0x5555 at offset IWDG_KR_OFFSET after the function call.
